title: Polar H10 HRV Session Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring daily readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), Whoop recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings body/blood-pressure (`withings:measure`), Dexcom CGM glucose (`dexcom:egv`).
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export, Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, Whoop, Withings, Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=polar:hrv
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(measurement_type) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Polar H10 HRV session events land each day and how many distinct measurement type values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Polar H10 HRV session records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct measurement type values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It predicts how much Polar H10 HRV session activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
